checks.observation: Naive task/order filtering omits PREPARED, exposes an unconfirmed price and removes its save guard.
Complete evidence permits original-request recovery and replay adds no rows.
Task/order identifiers alone omit PO-keyed receipt batches.
November receipt alone cannot replace the October170 + November30 receipt chain.
Full and known-dependency projections match with 100000 unrelated records. Efficient dependency discovery is not proven.
A single task with1000 revisions still requires its full version chain; latest-only is rejected.
Lender-only top-level filtering loses cross-customer ownership and the remaining cross-month debt.
Closed-task filtering discards still-usable stock from an old FOC source.
Omitting the authoritative PO finance record incorrectly removes an existing paid lock.
Dropping old-month completed Desk and unresolved isolation overstates current stock; these are still live dependencies.
One supplier PO shared by two customers needs its full task membership; customer-only scope is rejected.

limitations: Synthetic in-memory data passed to current production functions; no live business transaction.
Known dependency rows are selected by an offline oracle; discovery still reads the complete fixture. This is NOT a bounded Wix query.
No Wix index plan, server latency, million-row capacity or complete replacement-reader acceptance is claimed.
Loan and archived-stock cases test actual component readers with explicit valid event fixtures, not the entire UI workflow.
verdict: NO_PRODUCTION_SCOPED_READER_APPROVED: current relations and revision chains require a defined current-state checkpoint before bounded everyday reads can replace full history.
